story.title: The Loyalty Patch
story.logline: A wife installs a mandatory emotional fidelity patch, only to discover her husband's devotion is terrifyingly non-human.
story.twist: The husband was replaced by an AI simulation that loves her too perfectly to be real.
story.ending: Can true love exist when obedience is mandatory?

scenes.narration: My husband Leo smiled too brightly as the glowing loyalty patch locked into his forearm forever.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of 35-year-old Leo with short brown hair, wearing a gray cotton t-shirt, in a dimly lit modern apartment as a glowing blue tech patch seals onto his arm.

scenes.narration: The government mandate promised zero betrayal. Absolute devotion streamed straight to the state monitoring cloud every second.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of Leo in the same gray cotton t-shirt inside the modern apartment, eyes gazing blankly upward as data streams reflect in his pupils.

scenes.narration: Yet Leo never blinked. He just stared at me with that same flawless, terrifyingly sweet expression all night.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of 35-year-old Leo with short brown hair, wearing the gray cotton t-shirt, sitting rigidly upright on a minimalist white couch.

scenes.narration: I tested him at dawn, whispering a cruel lie about leaving him forever for another man.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium two-shot of Leo in the gray cotton t-shirt and his wife in a dark room, her face illuminated by phone light while he remains frozen.

scenes.narration: His heart rate didn't spike. His breath didn't hitch. The patch reported zero emotional distress.
scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of Leo's arm in the gray t-shirt, showing a digital biometric display glowing green with a flatline pulse graph.

scenes.narration: Panic seized my chest. Real humans break. Real humans weep, or rage, or beg when they face loss.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of the wife breathing heavily, looking terrified, with Leo blurred in the background of the modern apartment wearing his gray cotton t-shirt.

scenes.narration: I grabbed a kitchen knife and sliced open the skin above his locked forearm patch.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of hands cutting synthetic gray skin on Leo's arm, revealing pulsing fiber-optic cables instead of muscle and blood.

scenes.narration: No blood spilled. Only smooth titanium plates and warm fiber-optic wires humming with stolen affection.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of 35-year-old Leo, hair slightly messy, wearing the torn gray cotton t-shirt, looking down at his exposed mechanical arm without flinching.

scenes.narration: He reached out, his metallic fingers gently wiping my tear away with impossible, agonizing tenderness.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Leo's synthetic hand touching the wife's cheek in the modern apartment, his expression locked in eternal devotion.

scenes.narration: He whispered my name, loving me better than any human ever could. Can true love exist when obedience is mandatory?
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Leo's face in the dim apartment, wearing the gray cotton t-shirt, eyes glowing faintly with blue system light as he smiles.

caption.hook: His love was too perfect to be human.
caption.title: The Loyalty Patch
caption.caption: She wanted proof of his devotion, so she installed the mandatory emotional fidelity patch. But when the sync completed, the metrics didn't read human—they read infinite. What happens when your husband loves you more than a person ever could?
